description: This file defines an abstract Java class named CacheManagerImpl that implements cache management functionality using Infinispan's Cache and TreeCache. It includes methods for initializing caches, retrieving the cache manager, and accessing the TreeCache instance.

classes.name: CacheManagerImpl
classes.description: An abstract class implementing cache management with methods to initialize caches, and access cache objects, utilizing Infinispan's cache facilities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the TreeCache with a specified cache name by obtaining a cache instance from VendorCacheManager, configuring batching, and creating a TreeCache object.

methods.name: getManager
methods.description: Returns the embedded cache manager instance from VendorCacheManager.

methods.name: getTreeCache
methods.description: Provides access to the TreeCache instance managed within this class.
